requirements.requirement: Add strict orchestrator steering and role checkpoint schemas with continue, nudge, and stop_for_attention only; exact attempt/checkpoint binding; 60-second default continue; and no restart or cancel alias.

Compose report_supervision_checkpoint only at worker, validator, and terminal-review semantic boundaries; wait at most 60 seconds, privately consume a nudge once, and finish the current atomic effect before cooperative stop handoff. Add no restart, filesystem, process, provider, cancellation, patch, integration, promotion, or release authority.
Mirror the exact closed checkpoint, steering, body-free receipt/result, and stable error-code models needed by server and run control without adding a CLI carrier or restart/cancel alias.
Apply byte-equivalent supervision schema changes to the bundled mirror and prove no nudge body, private inbox locator, snapshot locator, or safe handoff body is public.

Use the one existing coordinator poller for the 30-second sparse policy and local role adapters. A due checkpoint is only a request; blocked or missing delivery continues, cooperative stop enters existing attention, and only accepted external decide_attention supersession may replace work.
Validate the closed action enum, exact generation binding, nullable node/review XOR, strict body placement, body-free receipt/result rows, and extra-member rejection for integrated MCP surfaces.

Add attachable inspect, report, and steer operation routing with exact project, mission, node-or-review, attempt, and checkpoint binding while advance_project runs. Keep existing cancel_run draining and cancellation semantics separate and unchanged.
Route attachable run control to the returned controller/supervision core without a second mutable worker, automatic retry, hidden restart, or body copy in run records, errors, logs, or results.

Expose strict orchestrator steer_attempt and role checkpoint schemas through MCP only, route mutations through the controller project lock, permit steering during attached advance_project, and never return the nudge body on the orchestrator surface.
Verify both public-surface mirror bytes and installed wheel/sdist lifecycle for checkpoint, steer, crash recovery, restart, privacy, and explicit-authority behavior.

Exercise real attached advance, inspect, and steer concurrency; exact stale, replay, and wrong-binding refusal; explicit cancel as a separate control; restart/idempotency; and no automatic restart or duplicate mutable effect.

Exercise strict MCP worker, validator, and terminal-review checkpoint schemas; orchestrator steering; timeout and delivery_blocked continuation; multibyte cap; receipt/body canaries; and unknown member/action refusal.
